name: Hair Detail Analysis
description: Examines hair strand detail and rendering quality
algorithm: Hair Detail Analysis — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes hair rendering detail for deepfake detection:

1. **머리카락영역Segmentation**: Hair regions are segmented per frame using semantic segmentation. The hair mass, hairline contour, and individual strand visibility are analyzed. Hair is one of the most challenging elements for AI generators due to its semi-transparent, fine-structured nature.

2. **Strand-Level분석**: In sufficient resolution, individual hair strands or strand groups should be visible. The method detects linear high-frequency features consistent with hair strands using oriented filters. AI-generated hair often appears as a smooth texture blob lacking individual strand detail, or shows repeating strand patterns (texture repetition).

3. **HairlineTransition분석**: The hairline — where hair meets forehead skin — is a critical forensic region. Natural hairlines show gradual transition with individual hairs and baby hairs. Deepfake hairlines may be unnaturally sharp, irregular, or show blending artifacts where the generated face meets the original hair.

4. **머리카락-빛Interaction**: Real hair shows complex light interaction: specular highlights following hair curvature (Marschner model), translucency at thin sections, and anisotropic reflectance. The method evaluates hair rendering against physical reflectance models. AI generators often produce over-simplified hair-light interaction.

5. **시간적머리카락안정성**: Hair maintains its large-scale structure across frames, with strand-level motion following physics (inertia, gravity, coherent flow). The method tracks hair consistency — deepfake generators may produce temporally unstable hair rendering with flickering texture, shifting hairline, or physically impossible hair motion.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through hair detail analysis analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
